reporting-org.narrative: European Commission - Directorate-General for International Partnerships

title.narrative: Activity under preparation EU-Vietnam Cooperation Facility

description.narrative:
The EU-Vietnam Cooperation Facility will support the project cycle management of all EU development programmes and will enhance EU-Vietnam policy dialogue. This will enable the EU to implement efficient strategies and achieve successful cooperation objectives in line with its political priorities, positioning the EU as a reliable partner of Vietnam. The contractor will provide the EU with robust high quality consulting services in a broad range of areas and through a wide set of activities, including, inter alia, technical assistance to project cycle management, capacity building, policy dialogue services, etc. The NDICI-Global Europe represents the main cooperation framework that these services aim to support.

Justification:

Can the procurement need be satisfied through an existing contract?

When the current EU-Vietnam Cooperation Facility contract finishes in November 2027, there will be no other contract to satisfy the needs.

How did you search the market and estimate the contract value?

Based on the current contract value.

Did you consider inter-institutional procurement?

Not applicable for this contract.

Did you consider environmental aspects (check if the selected CPV have a Green procurement indicator)

Not applicable for this contract.

Is there a risk that the Contractor causes damage to third parties (e.g. other suppliers, visitors on the Contracting authority¿s sites)?

No

What is the risk and the back-up solution if contract is not signed in due time?

There could be a gap between the end of the current contract and the beginning of the next one, hence potentially delaying some activities and disrupting continuity. The back-up solution may be to have a no-cost extension of the current contract if not all working days are used up.

If the procedure is recurrent what are the main conclusions from the previous call for tenders?

The contract adds good value to the work of the EUD, hence it needs to be continued. The identified bottlenecks of the implementation have been identified and will be addressed in the new contract accordingly.
